_comment: Generic leg roster. Copy it to the path that `roster.py path` prints first, then change it with the config skill so the checks run. No machine-specific account data belongs here.

merge_gate._comment: Who approves that a green verdict may land: 'user' (the person approves the verdict and the diff, the lead then merges and pushes in that same run) or 'lead' (a fully green verdict is its own approval). Absent means 'user'. Neither mode changes what counts as green: an unanswered review round, a failing test, an open blocker or an unverified finding goes to the person either way, and a stricter repo contract still wins. Change it with: roster.py gate <user|lead> --why "..."

r1._comment: First implementation round and its review legs.

opencode._comment: Picked by the lens the leg carries.

fallback.note: same leg, other pool; adds no family

fix._comment: A fix round can run fewer review legs than r1.
